create_clip_boxes: clip bounding box coordinates to fit within a frame resolution using xyxy format and resolution_wh tuple
create_pad_boxes: pad bounding box coordinates by adding px and py pixel values to expand box boundaries
create_denormalize_boxes: convert normalized bounding box coordinates to absolute pixel coordinates given resolution and normalization factor
create_move_boxes: reposition bounding boxes by applying an offset array with dx and dy translation values
create_scale_boxes: scale bounding box dimensions by a factor while keeping centers fixed
